verdict.rationale: The Daily notes core plugin opens a note for today's date or creates it if it doesn't exist, and can organize daily notes into folders by date format. The Templates core plugin supports template variables for dynamic content, and a community user confirms working with daily notes. missing for 10: explicit evidence that a daily-note template pre-fills each new note, evidence that the daily note opens automatically on startup as the default landing place, independent hands-on corroboration of the template-driven daily workflow.
